```{python}
from IPython.display import Markdown
from numbr import Cast as num
import datetime as dt
import yaml
import re

# Tools
def week(i):
    """Return integer `i` as ordinal word"""
    return num(i, target="Ordinal Word").capitalize()

def fmtdate(d):
    """Print date d"""
    return d.strftime("%B %-d, %Y")

def ra(page):
    """Print R&A with page"""
    return f'R&A p. {page}'

# Video links
# with open('../planning-book/_hymns.yml', 'r') as vf:
with open('./_hymns.yml', 'r') as vf:
    videos = yaml.safe_load(vf)

def get_url(hymn, urls=videos):
    """Get video URL for 'hymn' from `urls`. Returns 'No URL found' if the hymn is not found in the URL list."""
    # Remove punctuation and special characters
    hymn_key = re.sub('[^A-Za-z0-9 ]+', '', hymn.strip())
    # Replace spaces and make lowercase
    hymn_key = hymn_key.replace('  ', ' ').replace(' ', '-').lower()
    # Add hyperlink
    if hymn_key in urls.keys():
        return Markdown(f'[{hymn}]({urls[hymn_key]})')
    else:
        return Markdown(hymn)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

# First date
date = "2025-11-30"
date = dt.datetime.strptime(date, "%Y-%m-%d")

# First Respond & Acclaim page pairs (psalm and acclamation)
RA = [4, 5]

# Number of first liturgical week
litweek = 1

# Liturgical season
season = 'Advent'
```

All hymns are taken from the blue *Gather* hymnal unless otherwise noted. “R&A” indicates *Respond and Acclaim*. Christmas season Mass parts will be provided as handouts. Click on any title to listen to a recording for rehearsal purposes, but note that the lyrics may not match our hymnal. Please practice the lyrics in the *Gather* hymnal, regardless of the video.

::: {.callout-important title="Take note!"}
The Mass setting changes for Advent, the Solemnity of the Immaculate Conception, and Christmas.
:::
